indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS/NRAS/HRAS mutations at codons 12, 13, or 61 — includes PDAC, NSCLC, CRC cohorts
biomarker: KRAS G12X (including G12R), NRAS, HRAS at codons 12/13/61; PDAC RAS-WT also eligible
inclusion_match_notes: Indication matches (PDAC cohort), biomarker matches at codon-12 resolution (G12R covered by the codon-12/13/61 eligibility), line matches (post-FOLFIRI 2L+), and ECOG 0-1 fits ECOG 1. Orthogonal NGS / ctDNA G12R confirmation in target_validation.jsonl is the standard screening test for entry; recurrent-stage post-resection patients are within scope.
intervention_dosing: RMC-6236 oral, dose-escalation cohorts followed by RP2D in expansion

indication: Previously treated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
biomarker: RAS mutation (KRAS / NRAS / HRAS codon 12/13/61); G12R within scope
design: Randomized, open-label, phase 3 versus investigator's choice SoC
comparator: Investigator's choice of standard-of-care chemotherapy (gemcitabine ± nab-paclitaxel or NALIRIFOX-class)
inclusion_match_notes: RASolute 302 is the registrational PDAC trial for daraxonrasib in the 2L+ setting and biomarker-matches G12R. Listed as active not recruiting per registry, so enrollment is closed at most sites — eligibility is intact on biomarker and line, but the access window is the gating axis. Worth flagging because the read-out anchors any expanded-access / compassionate-use discussion the treating team may pursue.
intervention_dosing: RMC-6236 oral, registrational dose per protocol

indication: GI solid tumors (PDAC, CRC) with RAS mutation
biomarker: RAS mutation; subprotocols for G12D / G12X / G12C variants
design: Open-label multi-arm platform of RAS(ON) inhibitors as monotherapy and with chemotherapy
intervention: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) + chemo (mFOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel); RMC-9805 in G12D-specific subprotocols
inclusion_match_notes: Platform trial enrolling RAS-mutant GI tumors with PDAC arms across both 1L and post-progression settings; subprotocols cover G12X variants with the patient's G12R included in the pan-G12 cohorts. Combination chemo backbones (mFOLFIRINOX, gem/nab) are an option for a patient whose adjuvant exposure was FOLFIRI rather than FOLFIRINOX, leaving oxaliplatin-naive disease. Confirmed G12R on orthogonal NGS / ctDNA is the standard screening test.
intervention_dosing: RMC-6236 oral combined with mFOLFIRINOX or gem/nab per subprotocol

indication: Advanced / metastatic solid tumors with RAS mutation (NSCLC, CRC; PDAC eligibility per protocol)
biomarker: RAS mutation; RAS(ON) inhibitor backbone with ivonescimab PD-1×VEGF bispecific
design: Open-label dose-exploration and expansion combining RAS(ON) inhibitors with ivonescimab
inclusion_match_notes: Biomarker fits (RAS mutation including G12R) and the mechanism layers RAS(ON) blockade with PD-1×VEGF bispecific co-targeting — a rational direction for an MSS, immune-cold PDAC that otherwise has no ICI route. Whether PDAC is open at all sites depends on the cohort schedule; the primary published indications are NSCLC and CRC, so PDAC enrollment may be limited to specific dose-expansion arms. Confirm cohort openness with the sponsor.
intervention_dosing: RMC-7977 oral + ivonescimab IV per protocol; combination cohorts include cetuximab

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS mutations (G12C, G12D, G12V, G12R, G12S, G13D, Q61H) — NSCLC, CRC, PDAC
biomarker: KRAS pan-G12 / G13D / Q61H, including G12R
design: Phase 1 open-label dose-escalation + dose-expansion monotherapy and combinations
intervention: PF-07934040 pan-KRAS small-molecule inhibitor; combinations with gem/nab, FOLFOX, cetuximab, pembrolizumab
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility explicitly lists G12R as a covered variant — among the few first-in-human pan-KRAS programs that names G12R in the inclusion criteria rather than relying on broader codon-12 language. The 2L+ PDAC monotherapy cohort (Part 2a Cohort A1) matches the patient's recurrent post-FOLFIRI status; the 1L gem/nab combination arm (Part 2b Cohort A2) is more appropriate if first-line systemic therapy hasn't begun. Grade 2+ sensory neuropathy is an exclusion, which is a watch-item given prior FOLFIRI but irinotecan-based regimens are usually neuropathy-sparing.
intervention_dosing: PF-07934040 oral BID in 21-28 day cycles; combinations per protocol

indication: Locally advanced / metastatic solid tumors with KRAS mutations or amplification — NSCLC, PDAC, CRC
biomarker: KRAS G12V, G12D, G12C, G12R, G12A, G13D, or KRAS amplification (copy number ≥4)
design: Phase 1 IV dose-escalation + dose-expansion; combination with panitumumab in CRC
inclusion_match_notes: G12R is explicitly listed among the eligible KRAS variants and PDAC is one of the three named tumor types in the expansion cohorts. IV dosing is a small logistic distinction versus the oral-tablet programs; otherwise the biomarker / line / ECOG axes line up for a recurrent-PDAC patient post-adjuvant chemo. Confirm an active PDAC slot rather than relying on the global enrollment statement.
intervention_dosing: ASP5834 IV escalating doses; PDAC monotherapy expansion at RP2D

indication: Resected PDAC and other KRAS / NRAS mutant solid tumors in the adjuvant minimal residual disease setting
biomarker: KRAS / NRAS G12D, G12R, G12V, G12A, G12C, G12S, G13D — 7-peptide panel
design: Phase 1/2 with adjuvant MRD-anchored design and randomized phase 2 expansion (2:1)
intervention: ELI-002 7P (lipid-conjugated amphiphile KRAS peptide vaccine + immune-stimulatory oligonucleotide)
inclusion_match_notes: ELI-002 7P explicitly covers G12R among its seven KRAS / NRAS variants and is purpose-built for the MRD / adjuvant PDAC setting. The patient is *recurrent* post-adjuvant FOLFIRI rather than newly resected MRD-positive, so the eligibility fit hinges on whether a recurrence-curative-intent salvage with subsequent vaccine maintenance is permitted — likely not in the registered cohort. Status is active not recruiting, which further narrows access. Logged because mechanism-fit is unusually clean and the predecessor AMPLIFY-201 read out positively (Pant 2024 Nature Med, PMID 38195752).
intervention_dosing: ELI-002 7P subcutaneous prime / boost per protocol

indication: KRAS-mutated PDAC and other solid tumors in adjuvant MRD setting (AMPLIFY-201 final report)
biomarker: KRAS G12D / G12R amphiphile vaccine
endpoint: Safety, immunogenicity, ctDNA / tumor-marker reduction, RFS
effect_size: ctDNA reduction in 21/25 patients; T-cell response in 84%
inclusion_match_notes: AMPLIFY-201 final report. Includes G12R in the 2-peptide panel and shows that amphiphile KRAS vaccination drives measurable ctDNA reduction in MRD-positive resected PDAC and CRC. The patient is past the MRD window — disease is overt-recurrent rather than ctDNA-only MRD — so this row is a mechanism-precedent dossier entry rather than an enrollable trial. Anchors the rationale for the follow-on ELI-002 7P program (NCT05726864).

indication: Translational pharmacology of pan-RAS inhibition (RMC-6236, RMC-7977) in RAS-driven cancers including PDAC models
biomarker: RAS-GTP active-state
intervention: RMC-6236 (daraxonrasib) and RMC-7977 — RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitors
endpoint: Mechanism, tumor regression, on-target / off-target tolerance
inclusion_match_notes: Foundational pharmacology paper for the RAS(ON) multi-selective class — included as the mechanism-of-action anchor for daraxonrasib (NCT05379985) and zoldonrasib (NCT07397338). Not a clinical-efficacy trial; the row exists so the dossier has a citable pharmacology source when the board ranks the pan-RAS axis as the lead recommendation.

indication: Translational evaluation of RMC-6236 across RAS-driven cancers including PDAC patient-derived models
biomarker: RAS-GTP across G12X variants
endpoint: Activity across G12 variants in PDX / patient-derived organoids
inclusion_match_notes: Translational companion to the NCT05379985 first-in-human; the activity readouts across G12X variants (including G12R) anchor the rationale for offering this class to a G12R-mutant PDAC patient. Logged as a mechanism citation, not an enrollable trial.

indication: Previously untreated metastatic PDAC with KRAS activating mutation
biomarker: KRAS activating mutation (any G12X including G12R; G13D; Q61)
intervention: avutometinib (VS-6766, RAF/MEK clamp) + defactinib (FAKi) + gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel
inclusion_match_notes: Mechanism layers RAF/MEK clamp on FAKi on chemo — relevant to the KRAS axis through downstream MAPK and stromal-mechanotransduction blockade. Biomarker matches (KRAS-mutant PDAC including G12R) but line is 1L untreated metastatic; the patient is recurrent post-adjuvant FOLFIRI which the protocol may or may not count as prior systemic therapy. Status is active not recruiting, so access is the bottleneck rather than eligibility.
intervention_dosing: Avutometinib oral + defactinib oral + gem/nab IV per protocol cycles

indication: Borderline resectable / locally advanced PDAC
design: Randomized phase 2 (5:1) with SBRT plus FAK / RAF-MEK inhibition
inclusion_match_notes: Targets a different stage of disease (borderline resectable / LAPC) than the patient's recurrent post-resection status. Mechanism is still on-axis for the KRAS pathway via MAPK and stromal-mechanotransduction blockade, so the row is informational rather than enrollable.
intervention_dosing: SBRT + avutometinib oral + defactinib oral per protocol

indication: Metastatic refractory pancreatic cancer
inclusion_match_notes: PaTcH closed for futility in March 2026 — included as discontinued / decision-relevant context for any board discussion that wants to layer MEK + autophagy on the KRAS axis. The mechanism is the on-axis link (MEKi downstream of KRAS, HCQ targeting RAS-driven autophagy) but the negative readout argues against repeating this exact combination outside a redesigned protocol.
intervention_dosing: Trametinib 2 mg PO daily + HCQ 600 mg PO BID

indication: RAS-mutant solid tumors including PDAC
biomarker: RAS mutation
inclusion_match_notes: Biomarker basket of RAS-mutant solid tumors with PDAC eligibility and MEKi + autophagy mechanism on the KRAS axis. The PaTcH futility signal tempers expectations; this trial is logged because the basket structure and broader patient population may behave differently from the single-cohort PaTcH study.
intervention_dosing: MEKi oral daily + HCQ oral per protocol

indication: Advanced KRAS G12R altered PDAC
biomarker: KRAS G12R
design: Observational registry of MEK-based combination therapy
intervention: MEK inhibitor-based combinations (MEKi + HCQ, MEKi + EGFRi, etc.)
inclusion_match_notes: The most G12R-specific entry in the registry — captures real-world outcomes of MEK-based combinations in KRAS G12R PDAC. Not a therapeutic trial; the data this generates is what the board uses to weight off-label MEK / EGFR / autophagy combos against the pan-RAS arm.
intervention_dosing: Real-world prescribing — captured as observed

indication: Advanced solid tumors with actionable genomic alteration — basket
biomarker: CDKN2A loss, CDK4 / CCND1 / SMARCA4 alteration (palbociclib arm — now closed)
design: Canadian Profiling and Targeted Agent Utilization Trial (CAPTUR) — phase 2 basket
inclusion_match_notes: Group 8 (CDKN2A / CDK4 / CCND1 / SMARCA4) palbociclib arm of CAPTUR is the most direct basket match for the patient's CDKN2A loss + CCND3 alteration combination, but the arm is listed as closed — included as a precedent and to anchor the off-label-prescribing case if the treating center pursues palbociclib outside a trial. Mechanism is on-axis for CDKN2A loss and CCND3-driven CDK4/6 dependency.
intervention_dosing: Palbociclib 125 mg PO daily, 3 weeks on / 1 week off

indication: Rare solid tumors with actionable genomic alteration — platform
biomarker: CDKN2A mutation (palbociclib arm)
design: Genotyping-guided precision-medicine platform for rare tumors
inclusion_match_notes: Palbociclib arm of an NCI rare-tumor platform that takes CDKN2A-mutant tumors. PDAC is not 'rare' in the colloquial sense but the platform's definition turns on histology-frequency thresholds; eligibility hinges on site interpretation. CCND3 alteration is not in the named eligibility criteria but is biologically co-axial.
intervention_dosing: Palbociclib 125 mg PO daily, 3 weeks on / 1 week off

indication: Advanced PDAC selected by patient-derived organoid (PDO) drug sensitivity
biomarker: PDO sensitivity-based selection; genomic profiling overlay
intervention: Therapy from a menu including abemaciclib (CDK4/6), KRAS-directed agents, PARPi where indicated
inclusion_match_notes: ADOPT routes PDAC patients to therapy based on patient-derived organoid screening — a structural fit for a multi-feature case (KRAS G12R + CDKN2A loss + CCND3) where a single off-label option is hard to rank a priori. Listed as not-yet-recruiting; mechanism is on-axis via the CDK4/6 inhibitor option (abemaciclib) which targets the CDKN2A / CCND3 axis directly.
intervention_dosing: Per PDO-guided protocol

indication: Germline BRCA1/2-mutated metastatic PDAC, maintenance after first-line platinum
biomarker: Germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic mutation
inclusion_match_notes: POLO is the registrational evidence for olaparib maintenance in germline BRCA1/2-mutant metastatic PDAC after platinum response. The case has no germline data on file — the target_validation.jsonl row 'germline-pdac-hboc-lynch-lfs-panel' is the gating workup. Adjuvant FOLFIRI was irinotecan-based (no platinum), so platinum exposure is also a gating axis. Row is partial-fit until both germline and platinum-prior status resolve.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID

indication: Resected PDAC with germline or somatic BRCA1/2 or PALB2 mutation
biomarker: Germline / somatic BRCA1, BRCA2, or PALB2 pathogenic variant
inclusion_match_notes: APOLLO enrolls *resected* PDAC in the adjuvant setting. The patient is recurrent post-resection and post-adjuvant FOLFIRI, so the adjuvant-MRD eligibility window has closed. Logged because the BRCA / PALB2 mechanism would still be on-axis for olaparib in a non-adjuvant setting if germline testing turns positive — board should pivot to POLO-style maintenance after a platinum induction.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID

indication: Platinum-resistant esophageal / gastroesophageal junction cancer with TP53 mutation
biomarker: TP53 missense mutation (dominant-negative / GOF reactivation target)
inclusion_match_notes: Eprenetapopt reactivates mutant p53 conformation — designed for hotspot missense (R175H, R248, R273) rather than pure-loss-of-function or truncating variants. The patient's TP53 variant is described as 'inactivating' without missense class annotation; until the target_validation.jsonl 'tp53-lof-classification' row resolves the variant class, the mechanism fit is unknown and most likely off-target. Trial is terminated. Included as a single decision-relevant data point so the board can close the TP53-restoration axis cleanly.
intervention_dosing: APR-246 IV per protocol

indication: Previously untreated KRAS G12D-mutated metastatic PDAC (DAWN-303)
biomarker: KRAS G12D
inclusion_match_notes: G12D-selective by design — biomarker excluded for a G12R patient. Logged so the board sees the parallel class precedent: a KRAS-allele-selective + chemo backbone in PDAC is being tested at registrational scale, anchoring the rationale for the pan-G12X / pan-RAS programs that the patient *is* eligible for.
intervention_dosing: INCB161734 oral + chemo per protocol

indication: First-line KRAS G12D-mutated metastatic PDAC
biomarker: KRAS G12D
intervention: ASP3082 (setidegrasib, KRAS G12D-selective degrader) + mFOLFIRINOX or NALIRIFOX
inclusion_match_notes: G12D-selective degrader — biomarker excluded for a G12R patient. Same mechanism-class logic as INCB161734: a registrational allele-selective + chemo regimen in PDAC anchors the parallel for the pan-RAS / pan-G12X arms the patient is eligible for.
intervention_dosing: ASP3082 IV + chemo per protocol

indication: Advanced solid tumors with KRAS G12D mutation
biomarker: KRAS G12D
inclusion_match_notes: G12D-selective, terminated in March 2025 for formulation issues. Off-axis for G12R; logged as discontinued context for the board's view of the field.

indication: Advanced GI / biliary / pancreatic cancer with homozygous MTAP deletion
biomarker: Homozygous MTAP deletion (commonly co-deleted with CDKN2A)
intervention: anvumetostat (AMG 193 / PRMT5 inhibitor) + gem/nab or mFOLFIRINOX or RMC-6236
inclusion_match_notes: MTAP is co-deleted with CDKN2A in ~80-90% of CDKN2A homozygous deletions because the two genes are adjacent on 9p21. The patient's CDKN2A loss makes MTAP-deletion testing worthwhile and opens this trial as an option if the deletion extends to MTAP. Mechanism is on-axis for the CDKN2A-loss feature and the RMC-6236 combination arm also covers the KRAS axis. Add the MTAP IHC / NGS reflex to confirm.
intervention_dosing: Anvumetostat oral + chemo or RMC-6236 per protocol

indication: Solid tumors (GBM, melanoma, NSCLC, PDAC) with homozygous MTAP deletion
biomarker: Homozygous MTAP deletion
intervention: BMS-986504 (navlimetostat / PRMT5 inhibitor) ± daraxonrasib, immunotherapy, or chemotherapy
inclusion_match_notes: PDAC is a named tumor type and the daraxonrasib combination arm makes this a single trial that hits both the patient's KRAS G12R and CDKN2A-loss / MTAP-deletion features. Start date is July 2026 — access window starts later than the recruiting RAS(ON) trials. Confirm MTAP deletion status before banking on this row.
intervention_dosing: BMS-986504 oral ± daraxonrasib oral ± chemo or IO per protocol
